caption:
Ad spend doesn't fix a broken follow-up system.

It just feeds a bigger pipe into the same leak.

Most owners hit a slow month and reach for the ad budget first. But when follow-up is slow, doubling your leads just doubles how many go cold.

Cost per sale climbs. Revenue doesn't.

Fix the leak before you feed the pipe. Run your numbers through the free audit and see exactly where leads are dying.
